boss-ultimate-yeti.selection_goal: Third deterministic BOSS candidate after Dragon_Evolved and MushroomKing failed production gates. Big Yeti must prove dominant phone-scale silhouette, intact materials, exact shared animation compatibility and real Android readability before qualification.

verdict.reason: Immutable GitHub-hosted Quaternius Yeti GLB is now locked by commit, Git blob, byte size and SHA256. Validation #110 confirmed the repack preserves the Yeti mesh, packed Atlas_Monsters material and native Idle/Walk/Bite_Front/HitRecieve/Death family. Fresh exact 232-frame, silhouette-gate and visual evidence are still required before qualification.
